## Setup

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `git config --global user.name "Name"` | Set your identity |
| `git config --global user.email "email"` | Set your email |
| `git config --global --list` | View current config |

## Daily Workflow

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `git status` | **Most important!** See what's changed |
| `git add <file>` | Stage a specific file |
| `git add .` | Stage everything |
| `git diff` | See unstaged changes line by line |
| `git diff --staged` | See staged changes |
| `git commit -m "message"` | Record a snapshot |
| `git push` | Upload to GitHub |
| `git pull` | Download from GitHub |

## Branching

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `git checkout -b <name>` | Create & switch to new branch |
| `git checkout main` | Switch to main branch |
| `git branch` | List all branches |
| `git merge <branch>` | Merge branch into current |
| `git branch -d <branch>` | Delete a merged branch |
| `git push -u origin <branch>` | Push new branch to GitHub |

## History & Inspection

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `git log --oneline` | Compact commit history |
| `git log --oneline -5` | Last 5 commits only |
| `git log --stat` | Files changed per commit |
| `git log -- file.R` | Commits touching one file |
| `git show HEAD~2:file.R` | View file from 2 commits ago |

## Undoing Mistakes

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `git restore --staged file.R` | Unstage (keep changes) |
| `git restore file.R` | Discard changes ⚠️ destructive |
| `git reset --soft HEAD~1` | Undo last commit (keep changes) |
| `git stash` | Save work temporarily |
| `git stash pop` | Restore stashed work |
| `git commit --amend` | Fix last commit message |

## Commit Message Formula

**Complete the sentence: "This commit will..."**

- ✓ `"Add dose-response model for PFAS data"`
- ✓ `"Fix p-value calculation in Figure 3"`
- ✗ `"update"` / `"fix stuff"` / `"changes"`

## Closing Issues from Commits

```
git commit -m "Fix colorblind palette, closes #11"
```

Keywords: `closes`, `fixes`, `resolves`

## Keyboard Shortcuts (Posit Cloud)

| Action | Windows/Linux | Mac |
|--------|--------------|-----|
| New Terminal | Shift+Alt+R | Shift+Option+R |
